name: Xe-NONE
description: '''Xe-NONE''' is a [[Russians|Russian]] band from [[Kirov, Kirov Oblast|Kirov]], formed in mid-2004. It began when Lexy Dance (vocals, [[Programming (music)|programming]]) and Newman (synths, programming) worked on crossing a modern [[Metal music|metal]] and [[Electronic dance music|electronic dance]] sound, referred to as "Blood Rave [[Cyber Metal]]".
